messages:
olivia (AE): Quick thread  Prospect (Subscript Inc.) wants to kick off a 30-day POC but PO will be issued by their EU subsidiary and MSA by the US parent. They also attached a vendor SQ and asked for a KMS/HSM attestation. Need routing + who needs to review before we send esign.

pat (sales-ops): OrderForm uploaded: https://drive.internal/po/subscript-poc. Amounts: €16,200 initial, €5,400 activation. Template suggestion: OrderForm-MultiEntity-v2. I can attach PO + DPA + SQ in one envelope.

dana (finance): For €16.2k that's within sales-manager approval. Finance requires billing contact, VAT/tax id for the invoice entity, and PO number. AP wants PO attached and PO_NUMBER custom field so matching is automatic. Net30 default; Net60 needs director sign-off. Also need to know invoice entity for tax.

xiang (legal): Any redlines in the DPA or MSA? If the DPA adds residency obligations or new indemnities, hold before sending. Otherwise we can be post-sign reviewer. KMS attestation okay as an addendum (non-warranty). If they demand warranty or a vendor HSM certificate, route to infra (24-48h).

infra-bot: KMS attestation template available: https://legal.internal/templates/kms-attest-eu.docx. SOC2 link: https://security.redwood/soc2. Note: if they request specific vendor certs or FIPS validation, infra needs extra time. Recommended non-warranty sentence: "Redwood will store cryptographic keys used to protect Customer EU data in EU-based, HSM-backed key stores upon Customer's written request."

olivia (AE): Buyer insists the OF include a line: "Keys for EU customer data will be stored in EU HSMs." They want everything signed in one go (OF + DPA + KMS addendum). Can legal sign the addendum or only review?

xiang (legal): Legal will not normally sign the OF. We can attach the addendum and be a reviewer. We can sign the addendum only if its non-substantive and does not change warranties. If the PO or DPA replaces our SLA or adds residency warranty language, escalate to me.

pat (sales-ops): DocuSign template found: "OF-ME-v2". API override example: { "templateId": "OF-ME-v2", "signerOrder": ["ae","sales_mgr","finance","customer_exec"] }. Proposed signerOrder for this flow: AE placeholder -> Sales Manager -> Finance (attach PO) -> Customer Exec. Legal flagged as post-sign reviewer. I'll set custom fields: PO_NUMBER and BILLING_ENTITY.

dana (finance): That routing works. For multi-entity, AP needs invoice made out to the PO-issuing subsidiary. Please set BILLING_ENTITY to the subsidiary name and include VAT id. Also, if they insist on activation invoice being issued to parent, note that in the envelope metadata.

olivia (AE): Buyer says PO will come from subsidiary tonight and they want signatures by EOD tomorrow. I'll request VAT id + billing contact now. If infra needs to validate HSM availability in EU region, will they block?

infra-bot: EU HSM-backed key stores are available in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1. If they require a specific vendor or FIPS cert, infra must review and provide artifact (24-48h). For wording in addendum, stick to non-warranty attestation as suggested.

pat (sales-ops): Plan: prepare single envelope with OF + standard DPA + KMS addendum + vendor SQ. Signer order = [ae_placeholder, sales_mgr, finance_billing, customer_exec]. Attach PO when received, set PO_NUMBER and BILLING_ENTITY. Legal set as post-sign reviewer.

dana (finance): Approved provided PO and VAT arrive. AP will accept PO in envelope. If buyer requests Net45/Net60, route for director approval.

xiang (legal): Drafted KMS addendum and uploaded: https://legal.internal/drafts/kms-attest-subscript-v1.docx. Language is non-warranty and region-bound per infra guidance. I'll monitor if they propose redlines.

olivia (AE): PO arrived and VAT provided. Pat - please send envelope and cc accounting. Buyer wants signatures today.

pat (sales-ops): Sending envelope now. Template = OF-ME-v2, signer order set, attachments included, PO_NUMBER and BILLING_ENTITY fields populated. Legal flagged as reviewer. :white_check_mark:

dana (finance): AP received PO copy and will reconcile after signatures. Net30 confirmed.

xiang (legal): Monitoring for post-sign redlines. If they later add warranty language around keys or SLA changes, notify me immediately.

olivia (AE): Thanks team. I'll start the POC after execution. Closing thread once fully signed. :rocket:
